subject: ext-f
title: EXT.F.------TH.CONT.
description: Diagram in CMBA-20, the first of three on book p264. EXT-FT (extended functionalism) is crossed with TH-CONT (thrust continuance). TH-CONT is itself fed by AFI (affinity insight) and (P)INFO-DOC (the *point of activation* of information documentation, marked with the (p) prefix). EXT-FT then outputs to PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) and PROG-EXT-FT (progressional extended functionalism). PROG-EXT-FT branches to PER-TRS (perceived transition), APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions), and MT-INFO (music information). (R)ALT-C-PG (the reality of alternative composite progressionalism) feeds EXT-FT. Structural argument: extended functionalism in CMBA-20's modal-functionalism context is fed by both the reality of alternative composite progressionalism *and* by thrust continuance — and thrust continuance itself requires affinity insight grounded in the point-of-activation of information documentation. Once active, extended functionalism produces projectional dynamics and progressional-extended-functionalism, with the latter fanning into perceived transition, applied redefinitions, and music information. The diagram thus diagrams the *prerequisites* for the modal-functionalism move: it requires both a real alternative-composite-progressionalism (already operative) *and* affinity-insight-grounded thrust continuance — meaning Davis's 'So What' couldn't have happened without both upstreams already in place.
